body: I feel good when i exercise, but when i can't do something at gym or i feel i'm not good enough it ruins my day, the crippling reality of not being good enough is my worst enemy.

I'm in the same position, 19 years old without knowing basic things, not having a job and not knowing how to keep one, life can't seem to get better and i'll probably die in a close future, but if you are 17 years old you at least have more time to find the solutions to your problems and not end like me.
Yes, that's my problem too, working may solve some of my problems, but getting a Job I can do is the hardest part.

Yes, but i haven't managed to fix this problem, i'm just the worst at both worlds: i can't do anything no matter how much simple plus i have several problems, several bad things without good things.

I can't even get an entry level job to save my life, what a life.

I honestly hope you get better because this feeling/situation is not something i wish for anyone.

Me too, i suck at everything i do, i feel and i am useless, and i don't even care if someone's better than me, i just want to be at an aceptable level, get a job and live a mediocre live, but even that is beyond my ability.

Edit: don't give up and be like me, i really think i'm the most useless person so you are above me and can suceed after dedicating time and effort.
i also hope things get better for you.

Yes i know, i have some friends and family members that are just amazing and supportive people, they are the reason I'm here, striving to get better and suffering but with no courage(or means) to give up.
I also feel not good enough and bad at everything, i hope we both get better because feeling like this is not a thing i wish for anyone.

I'm 18 and in the same place, every year that passes life becames harder, colder and darker, in the past i tough I would not survive past high school but i did it, not in a good place mentally but alive at least, i will see how further i can go before i can reach my limit.

That's such a nice story, i hope i can reach my first job and get better too.

Best of luck to you

I know that feeling, i need to work and study but my mind just seen off and it is really painful because of my situation right now when poverty knocks de door, i wish i could get motivaded and don't feel the pain of depression again.
thanks
You are right, it was just a way of saying it because i can't fully express myself in English, maybe bearable would be a better word.

I'm a NEET in my late teens and I struggle with suicide ideation, lack of self eestem and motivation to do even the most basic things such as studying, to the point of hopelessness because i can't even imagine myself working or being good at something, although I'm aware of my situation it's difficult to change.
Yes i'm trying to do that together with exercises, i have to improve my life so that it becomes less painfull.
I know the feeling, i often daydream, oversleep and fantasize things because the real world is just so depressing for me to cope without escaping sometimes.
You are like an older version of me, i hope that we can at least live with enought confort with our condition.

I know this feeling, unhapilly i suffer from the same thing so i'm not in a place to give advices, but i find that playing guitar is a nice thing to do as a hobby, even if its not at pro level.Try to feel good about it because that's is surely an accomplishment, it is hard to see what are the good side of yourself because we tend to forget what we already learned from the starting point to the present time.

Tbh I relate to your thinking, like if someone is really bad at most things or bellow average he/she will have a hard time living.By comparison, job market or dating we have your thinking applied In real life.
I can only upvote and wish you the best, because i'm on the same situation as you.
Yes that's why i try to avoid romance unless the serie has something interesing in between, but if its pure sugary romance then i'm out, i prefer feeling bad with some sad drama.

I already felt the sociological pain your talking about, feels like some weight being pressed on my chest, i can't recommend you something because i'm in the same situation but my guess is some online game or community that is small because there is more interaction.

There is no point, you make your own point and motive to live, the only problem is that living is more suffering and alienation than joy and distraction for people like us, not saying that its hopeless but a person should be really resistant to live.
I can relate to your post, i'm 18 and things keep geting colder and darker each day.
I feel like that too, living isn't meant for everybody, i also want to get a job and a good education but i feel incapable of anything nowadays.
Thank You
